topic: Effects of Earth's rotation and revolution
key_concepts: Earth rotates on its axis in a counterclockwise direction
Earth's rotation causes day and night
The Sun appears to rise in the east and set in the west
Earth revolves around the Sun in an elliptical orbit
Earth's axis is tilted at 23.5 degrees
Earth's revolution and axial tilt cause seasons in temperate regions
Summer begins in the Northern Hemisphere around June 21 or 22
Autumn begins around September 22 or 23 with equal day and night
Winter begins around December 21 or 22 with short daylight in the Northern Hemisphere
Spring begins around March 21 with equal day and night
Temperate regions experience four seasons: summer, autumn, winter, and spring
Seasons change about every three months
